fitch._note: July 2016: Fitch affirmed BBB+, revised outlook from Stable to NEGATIVE following marked 2016 financial deterioration

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Significant turnaround — outlook went from Negative (2016) to Positive (April 2019), bypassing Stable. Fitch signaled upgrade possible during 2-year outlook cycle.

outcome_class_rationale: Started window on Negative watch (downgrade likely per Fitch). Ended window on Positive watch. Net trajectory: averted downgrade and improved outlook two notches. Rating itself unchanged at BBB+.

operating_metrics_fy2016._warning: Negative operating margin reflects Fitch's 'marked financial deterioration in 2016' framing. Industry-typical estimates anchored to large rural KY system with heavy debt load post-new-hospital build.

ma_events_2017_2018._note: Muhlenberg acquisition occurred 2015, PRIOR to window. Twin Lakes was 2020-2021, AFTER window.

_research_notes: Heavy capital burden from new Owensboro Health Regional Hospital opened 2013. 2016 deterioration was post-construction stabilization issue. By 2019 ops had recovered enough for outlook to flip to Positive.
